The project looks correct now. Here's a summary of the four issues I fixed:

**1. Cross-product batching in validation (line 54-58)**
The original `ValidateGeneratedCode` target referenced `%(ProtoFile.Filename)` and `%(ValidationRule.Filename)` in one task without target-level batching. MSBuild treated this as a cartesian product (3×2=6 unstructured executions). Fixed by adding `Outputs="%(ProtoFile.Identity)"` to batch the target per proto file, with the Message task then inner-batching on ValidationRule — giving structured "for each file, apply all rules" semantics.

**2. CS2002 duplicate source files (line 16)**
The original `<Compile Include="**\*.g.cs">` added files that the SDK already auto-includes (all `*.cs`) AND that the target re-added. Changed to `<Compile Update="**\*.g.cs">` which only sets metadata on already-included items without duplicating them.

**3. Clean removed too many files (line 64)**
`Remove="**\*.g.cs"` would strip all `.g.cs` files from compilation, including legitimate non-proto-generated sources. Now it only removes the specific proto-generated files via the transform `@(ProtoFile->'...')`.

**4. Generated files not tracked across incremental builds (lines 22-26)**
When `GenerateProtoCode` was skipped (up-to-date), the in-target `<Compile Include=...>` never ran, so generated files disappeared from compilation. Moved the include to a static ItemGroup (line 23-25) that always evaluates, and removed the redundant in-target include.
